newsitem.title: UK: INSTANT VIEW - Economic views of British budget.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW - Economic views of British budget.

text.p: Following is a selection of economists' reactions to Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke's 1996 annual budget statement.
For a full breakdown of budget news - UK/BUDGET
GERARD LYONS, CHIEF ECONOMIST AT DKB INTERNATIONAL

"As expected he's giving a very upbeat assessment on the economy. He's right to predict strong growth next year and low inflation next year. But he's predicting too good a balance of growth. He's too optimistic on investment and on exports.

"He's obviously playing a very cautious stance on borrowing. It's pretty much like last year's budget and we're still looking for a three billion giveaway. So far, the markets haven't been spooked by anything."
